title: Kagamine Rin — A Tomboyish Melody〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Sigh*... I'm bored...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The girls won't be here for a while, so I guess I can play something until then...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Aha! Found you, Rin♪
Right where Miku said you'd be!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Sakki, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're alone...? Where are the others? Practice isn't for a while, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I thought that I'd practice on my own a little, and chat with you, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
With me?
Oh, is this about your song?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everyone's been talking about how well it's coming along☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it is! But there's something else that I wanna talk to you about.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Or rather, something I wanna do with you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: First, I need you to take a look at this...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? A notebook...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! It's my List of 100 Things to Do Once I'm Back in School...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what?! That sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Growing up, I've always been getting sick and wasn't really able to go to school. I've been writing in this for when I did finally get better!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And there's this one page... Here!
I wanna do this one with you, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Lemme see! Lemme see!
Um... Talk like high school girls...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanted to try this with Ichi and the others, but I feel like they would've been too embarrassed about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?
Also, what do you actually mean by this...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right! Lemme explain...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, okay! So just talk using secret words and phrases that only high school girls know!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, exactly♪
I looked up stuff online and in magazines all the time when I was in the hospital. I even wrote them down!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Some of them aren't really in style anymore, but here... They're on this page...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, that's a lot!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? This sounds like the name of a place... Um, Florida?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That actually comes from the Japanese word for bath and how you'll be gone for a little bit while you take one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, wow! I never would've gotten that! It really is like a secret code!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right?! Oh, this is one of my favorites...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
BFF...?
Is it an abbreviation for something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! It's short for Best Friends Forever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that's so cool!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sakki, teach me more!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got it♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Ichi!
And Shiho and Hona! Hi♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hi, yourself. Did you forget when we're meeting up?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What?! I'm ten minutes late?! Sorry, I was talking with Rin and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Miku let us know that you were already here, so I figured you were fine but...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Take a chill pill, Shih. You're making both of us feel all #sadface.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-Hashtag sad face...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Nice one, Rin!
That was so cute!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Let's try it all together!
For Sakki's sake?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For Saki's sake?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki's notebook about all the things she wants to do...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm helping her fulfill her dream of talking like high school girls♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But Sakki said that you girls would be too embarrassed to try it...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Rin, don't...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Is that true...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, so let's do it together!
They're the ones you really want to do this with, right, Sakki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I mean... That is...
If it's okay with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be okay if I took a look at your notebook, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then I'd like to as well!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, sticker bombing. You do that to us all the time, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Usually using the one that says, Let's Have Lunch Together!

rows.Speaker: Ichika・Honami
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And at night she's always like, I Don't Wanna Go To Bed Yet!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. How about we just call those her attention stickers from now on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That's pretty cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I love you all so much♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Hehe♪ Good for you, Sakki!)
